<!--
Build (from the repository root), after the pipeline has produced rebuttal/results/:

  apptainer exec rebuttal/container/quarto.sif \
    quarto render rebuttal/manuscript/manuscript.qmd -P results:$PWD/rebuttal/results

or via the workflow: snakemake -s rebuttal/Snakefile manuscript
-->

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
source("../R/plots.R")
res_dir <- params$results
schemes <- unlist(params$schemes)
iter <- read_tsvs(file.path(res_dir, schemes, "per_iteration.tsv"))
null_counts <- read_tsvs(file.path(res_dir, "null_counts.tsv"))
pca_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "figures", "pca")
datasets <- c("brca", "kirc", "lihc", "luad", "prad", "thca", "immuno", "yeast", "pseudo")
pca <- lapply(setNames(datasets, datasets), function(d) read_tsvs(file.path(pca_dir, sprintf("pca_%s.tsv", d))))
scree <- lapply(setNames(datasets, datasets), function(d) read_tsvs(file.path(pca_dir, sprintf("scree_%s.tsv", d))))
fig2_datasets <- c("immuno", "kirc")
other_datasets <- setdiff(datasets, fig2_datasets)
```

::: {#suppfig-pca}

```{r}

#| fig-height: 13
wrap_plots(lapply(pca[other_datasets], pca_plot), ncol = 3) +
```

PCA of the remaining datasets.

:::

::: {#suppfig-scree}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 11
wrap_plots(lapply(scree[other_datasets], scree_plot, metric = "variance"), ncol = 3, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
```

Scree plots (absolute variance) of the remaining datasets.
